413-978--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

147-728-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

38-301-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
38-301-7804.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and then putting the card back on top of your library.
Repeat.

4067-4343-4435-7802.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a card in hand.
4067-4343-4435-7802.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw two cards due to Alhammarret's Archive.
Seven of Nine triggers, causing you to draw two cards due to Alhammarret's Archive.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
4067-4343-4435-7802.notes: You can skip step 5 if an opponent controls an untapped creature.

2928-3652-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2928-3652-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4069-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

997-5088-5211-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
997-5088-5211-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, scrying 1.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, scrying 1.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

240-413-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

57-4235-4785-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4785-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-3594-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4659-5220-5651.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
4659-5220-5651.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

918-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
918-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
918-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Donna Noble.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing 100 damage to target opponent.

2034-2043-3129-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
2034-2043-3129-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

224-3113-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Fire Whip attached to Avenging Druid.
224-3113-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

500-914-3125-4867-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
500-914-3125-4867-5147.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dockside Extortionist and the token Cormela trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

20-751-1558.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat four additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Gyome triggers, creating five Food artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Foods, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3096-4322.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than the number of cards in your library rounded up to the nearest multiple of seven.
3096-4322.description:
Activate Griselbrand by paying 7 life, causing you to draw seven cards.
Repeat until you draw from an empty library, winning the game.

2464-3099-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
2464-3099-3525.description:
Activate the creature with Pemmin's Aura attached by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance's ability.

2882-3819-4221-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two land cards in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
2882-3819-4221-5220-5256.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Living Plane and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the land on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to the land's power.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put any other land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

927-1406.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Covetous Dragon to an opponent who controls no artifacts.
When Covetous Dragon's controller controls no artifacts, Covetous Dragon triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Covetous Dragon cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Covetous Dragon triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1479-1671-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-4288.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
